campaign: xcvrd Python->Rust, CodeWeaver, with a benchmark/optimize extension
subject: sonic-xcvrd (SONiC transceiver daemon)

oracle.name: xcvrd-tests
oracle.style: black-box on STATE_DB; never imports the daemon
oracle.why: The repair loop hands the Translator the failing test node ids plus the Validator's diagnostics, and explicitly instructs it to re-read those tests. Agents also run with read access to the suite. This arm is test-INFORMED by design and must not be pooled with the test-blind CodeWeaver column in this directory's other packages.

stub_baseline_note: Not measured. Unlike CRUST-bench there is no stub crate to score, so this package cannot say what an unimplemented daemon would score. A no-op daemon control was run separately in sonic-dev (transceiver_tests_noop) and fails the STATE_DB-backed tests, but it was not scored through this oracle and is not reported as a number here.

codeweaver.what: the pipeline run to correctness: analyze -> scope -> plan -> (translate <-> validate) x milestone -> parity_verify

codeweaver-optimized.what: continues from the codeweaver arm: benchmark <-> optimize rounds, then one full-suite conformance milestone

denominators_differ: The two arms do not share an e2e denominator. The codeweaver arm was gated on the cumulative milestone selection with deferred tests deselected (104); the optimized arm ran the entire suite with no -k gate (105). They are a before/after pair on one artifact, not two independent samples, and neither column is a pass rate over the same set.
